A.biggest_weakness: It does not visually illustrate the orthogonality integral (how integrating f(x)·sin(kx) cancels out for even harmonics) nor compare decay rates with other waveforms like triangle or sawtooth waves.

B.biggest_strength: Rich mathematical depth, notably Scene 5's visual area-cancellation proof for Fourier coefficients and comprehensive reference tables comparing convergence across different wave types.
